description: MainActivity.java for an Android app implementing fingerprint authentication using the Android Keystore system. Handles UI interactions, key generation, and biometric authentication flow.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling fingerprint authentication and key management for secure purchase flow.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks device security, creates cryptographic keys, and sets up the purchase button action.

methods.name: initSignature
methods.description: Initializes the Signature object with the generated key for authentication.

methods.name: onPurchased
methods.description: Callback for successful purchase, displays confirmation with encrypted data.

methods.name: onPurchaseFailed
methods.description: Displays a toast message when purchase fails.

methods.name: showConfirmation
methods.description: Displays confirmation message and optionally shows encrypted data.

methods.name: createKeyPair
methods.description: Generates an asymmetric key pair in the Android Keystore, requiring user authentication for key use.
